data.content_ref: inline:Adopt a proof-theoretic grounding: define acceptance by existence of a canonical, polynomial-time-checkable dialectical proof tree whose leaves are committed roots, and treat the fixed-point labeling only as a sanity check. This changes the semantics from a global fixed point to a local proof search. Criticizable because proof-tree existence may not be monotone under edge addition unless the tree language is carefully restricted, and it may reintroduce self-support if cycles are not handled explicitly.
